# **Reception Module** 

# Patient Registrations and Managing Patient Appointments     

# **Overview**

## **1\. Document Information**

| Field | Placeholder |
| ----- | ----- |
| Module | Reception Module |
| Version | v1.0 |
| Date Created | 15th August 2025 |
| Last Updated | 15th October 2025 |
| Review | Product team in liaison with Engineering team |

## **2\. Purpose**

This workflow allows reception staff to efficiently manage patient appointments, whether for new 

patients, existing patients without appointments, or patients with pre-booked appointments. It ensures

accurate registration, appointment booking, collection of consultation fee and check-in to facilitate 

smooth consultation flow.

## **3\. Scope**

Covers the processes including registration, searching patients, booking appointments, marking check-in, 

and starting consultations. 

## **4\. User Persona Context**

Reception staff handle patient intake, verify details, either check or book appointments, collect 

consultation fee and ensure patients are ready for doctors on time.

## **5\. Prerequisites**

### **5.1 System Requirement**

* Users must be logged  into the CARE platform with valid credentials.  
    
* The reception role must be assigned.

### **5.2 Knowledge Requirement**

* The reception staff must know how to register new patient details or search patients by phone   
    
  number or name.  
    
* The reception staff must be aware of how to book an appointment. 

## **6\. Expected Outcome**

* The new patient details are successfully registered in the CARE platform.  
    
* The appointment slot assigned to the selected location/healthcare service/practitioner as confirmed.  
    
* The patient is displayed under the **Checked-in** or **In-consultation** status in the **Appointments**   
    
  section for the selected date.  
    
* The consultation process is ready to begin with the doctor being able to access the patient’s   
    
  encounter immediately.  
    
* After scheduling an appointment, the system will display an **OPD Slip** which can be printed.  
    
* The encounters are accessed when the consultation starts.

## **7\. Login (Reception Staff)** {#7.-login-(reception-staff)}

**Step 1**: Login to the CARE platform with your credentials.

![][image1]

**Step 2**: Select the associated facility from the **Facilities** list.

![][image2]

**Step 3**: List down a set of options including **Overview, Appointment, Queues, Patient, Services,** 

**Resource, Users, Billing, Settings**.

![][image3]

**Step 4**:  The **Patient** section lists down various options including **Search Patient, Encounter (different types), Locations**. 

## ![][image4]

## **8\. Step-by-Step Instructions**

The role of reception includes patient registration, checking appointments, booking appointments when 

required, collecting consultation fee payments, and marking patients as checked-in for doctors to begin 

consultations.

## **8.1 New Patient Without Appointment**

### **8.1.1 Patient Registration**

**Step 1**: [Login to the CARE platform as instructed and navigate to the Patients section and select Search](#7.-login-\(reception-staff\))   

[patients.](#7.-login-\(reception-staff\))

**Step 2**: Following, continue with the steps outlined below.

**Step 3**: Click **Add New Patient**.  

![][image5]  
**Step 4**: Enter **Full Name**, **Date of Birth**, **Contact Details**, **Gender**, **Address**  and **Identifiers**.

![][image6]

**Step 5**: Click **Register Patient** to register the patient. 

### ![][image7]

### **8.1.2 Book Appointment for the New Registered Patient**

**Step 6**: After the patient is registered, it directs to schedule an appointment.

**Step 7**: Click **Schedule Appointment**. 

![][image8]

**Step 8**: Select the **Location/Practitioner/Healthcare Service** where the booking needs to be made for the 

practitioner for consultation, and the **next available time slot will be autoselected for the date selected**.

**Step 9**: Click **Confirm Appointment.**   
   
**![][image9]**

**Step 10**: The system will display **Appointment Details**.

![][image10]

**Step 11: Click on the Create Invoice button for the General Category patient.**  
**![][image11]** 

**Step 12:** Complete the Billing process by clicking on **“Create Invoice” \> “Issue Invoice” \> “Record Payment”  \> Mark as Balanced**  
 *(These steps can be easily done by using shortcuts keys.)*  

**Step 13**: The Patient’s name comes under **Booked status** in the **Appointments** section for the selected 

practitioner and selected date.  

![][image12]

### **8.1.3 Billing For the OPD Fee**

**Step 1**: Select the “Create Invoice” option from the Appointment Details screen  
**![][image11]**

**Step 2**: Click on the Create Invoice button   
**![][image13]**

**Step 3:** Click on the Issue Invoice button  
**![][image14]**

**Step 4:** Select the Record Payment

**![][image15]**

**Step 5:** Update the payment location and click on Record payment button   
**![][image16]**

**Step 6:** Once the payment has been received from the patient, click on “Mark as Balanced” and go back to the appointment page.   
![][image17]

### **8.1.4 Mark Appointment as Checked-in and Start Consultation**

**Step 12**: Navigate to the Location’s Appointments section. 

![][image18]

**Step 13**: The appointment list displays patients under different statuses:

* **Booked**

* **Checked-in**

* **In-consultation**

* **Fulfilled**

* **Non Fulfilled**

**![][image19]**

**Step 14:** Click on the patient's name to go to Appointment Details. Click **Print Appointment** to generate the **OPD Slip.**

![][image20]

**Step 16**: The OPD Slip gets  generated in a printable format.

**![][image21]**

**Step 17**: Then the patient can be checked-in by clicking the **Check-In** option.

![][image22]

**Step 18**: After clicking on checked-in reception staff’s role is over. Next, an OPD Nurse takes over and she/he needs to click **Start Consultation** to get the patient into the consultation. 

![][image23]

**Step 19:** Once the option is clicked, initiate the encounter for the patient by filling the **Type of encounter** 

and all other details and then click **Create Encounter.**

**![][image24]**

**Step 20**: The status of the patient changes automatically from **Booked** to **In-consultation** under   
**Appointments**.

### **8.1.5 Reschedule or Cancel Appointment** {#8.1.5-reschedule-or-cancel-appointment}

**Step 1**: Login to the CARE platform as instructed and navigate to **Healthcare Services**

**Step 2**: Select the OPD Department and select the patient appointment card to reschedule or cancel

**Appointment details**.     

![][image25]                         **Step 3**: To **reschedule**, click the More options and select the Reschedule option

![][image26]

**Step 4**: Select a new green-marked slot from the calendar view and confirm the new time and then click 

**Schedule Appointment** option.

![][image27]

**Step 5**: Mark as **Entered in Error** or **Cancel Appointment** instead of **Reschedule** option for incorrect 

bookings or cancel the booked appointments at any time.

![][image28]

**Step 6**: The status will be updated accordingly once the changes are done.

## **8.2 Existing Patient Without Appointment**

### **8.2.1 Search for Patient**

**Step 1**: [Login to the CARE platform as instructed and navigate to the Patients section and select Search](#7.-login-\(reception-staff\))   

[patients.](#7.-login-\(reception-staff\))

**Step 2**: Following, continue with the steps outlined below.

**Step 3:** Search using the Patient Phone Number.       

![][image5]

**Step 4**: Verify the patient using the patient's year of birth.

![][image29]

**Step 5**: Open the Patient’s profile and access the patient record for further actions like scheduling an 

appointment.

### **8.2.2 Book Appointment for an Existing Patient**

**Step 6**: Click **Schedule Appointment**.

![][image30]

**Step 7**: Select the **Location** and pick an available time slot marked in green for a selected date.

**Step 8**: Click **Schedule Appointment.** 

**![][image9]**

**Step 9**: The system will display  the appointment details along with the  **Print Appointment** option to generate the OPD Slip.

![][image31]

**Step 10**: The Patient’s name comes under **Booked status** in the **Appointments** section of the healthcare services for the selected 

![][image32]

### **8.2.3 Mark Appointment as Checked-in and Start Consultation**

**Step 11**: Navigate to the **Appointments** section in the Healthcare services

**Step 12**: Select the required service, in this case it’s OPD. 

![][image33]

**Step 13**: The appointment list displays patients under different statuses:

* **Booked**

* **Checked-in**

* **In-Consultation**

* **Fulfilled**

* **No-show**  
    
* **Cancelled**


![][image34]

**Step 14: The user** clicks on a patient's name to go to **Appointment Details** and proceed with action **Check-in** and their role ends here. 

**Step 15:** Next, the OPD nurse clicks on **Start Consultation** and continues to the next stage of marking the patient's basic vitals.

**![][image35]**

**Step 17**: After the doctor’s consultation, the Doctor/Nurse can mark the appointment as Completed.

[To Reschedule or Cancel the Appointment, do the steps accordingly.](#8.1.5-reschedule-or-cancel-appointment)

## **9\. Patient Registration Through ABHA**

**Step 1**: Patient scans the ABHA QR code fixed on the OPD Counter by the ABHA Application.  

Note: The ABHA QR code can be generated in the CARE Facility management system. 

## ![][image36]     

**Step 2**:  Patient registers on the ABHA app like below \- 

![][image37]

**Step 3**: Patient generates a Token on the ABHA app

![][image38]

**Step 4:** The generated token will be shared with the reception staff and the reception staff will login on CARE and search the token number in the **‘Search Patient’** field. 

![][image39]

**Step 5**: After locating the patient file in the CARE system, reception staff will schedule the appointment and generate an OPD slip. 

## 

## **10\. Error Handling / Common Issues**                         


| Error Message / Issue | Possible Cause | Resolution |
| ----- | ----- | ----- |
|  |  |  |
| Patient Not Found | Incorrect year of birth or wrong phone number entered. | Re-enter correct patient details and verify year of birth. |
| Appointment slot not Available | The selected location/practitioner/healthcare services has no open slots for the chosen date and time. | Create new slots based on availability and redo the exercise. Contact Admin staff.  |
